content: You will be given an essay and asked about to annotate a specified part from it. Choose the argumentative role of the given sentence from list 1.opp (opponent), 2.pro (proponent). Choose only one label.

The choice of an attending physician is at the discretion of the patient. Yet the funds of the health insurance companies are a common benefit for all premium payers. They should not be spent on personal preferences without proven use. The effectiveness of many natural remedies has not been demonstrated. Therefore no unproven and unrecognized treatments by naturopaths should be reimbursed by the insurance companies.
What is the argumentative role of "Yet the funds of the health insurance companies are a common benefit for all premium payers." from the given essay? choose from 1. opp 2. pro
